Subsequently, it enriches each game with contextual metadata such as opening lines, rest days, and schedule density. These enriched signals are then used to construct GameContextInput objects consumed by the prediction engine. The isBootstrap flag ensures that GameSignals carry correct provenance regardless of ingestion path. The system assumes all paths converge on identical behavior, with failure modes arising from divergent gate states or enrichment errors. The pipeline's robustness hinges on immutability of derived values and explicit propagation of bootstrap status.
